title: Serino 2018 · mixed-reality visual–tactile PPS
citation: Serino, A., Noel, J. P., Mange, R., Canzoneri, E., Pellencin, E., Ruiz, J. B., Bernasconi, F., Blanke, O., & Herbelin, B. (2018). Peripersonal Space: An Index of Multisensory Body–Environment Interactions in Real, Virtual, and Mixed Realities. Frontiers in ICT, 4, 31.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

visual.object: Virtual tennis ball approaches the face, starting nominally 2 m away.

published_method.target: 10 ms solenoid pulse to right cheek.
published_method.response: Make a speeded button press when the cheek is touched; ignore the animated ball and withhold on trials without touch.
published_method.analysis: Compare each multisensory delay's mean RT with the participant's fastest mean tactile-only delay. Fit the uncorrected multisensory means for the PPS transition.

value.tactile: Mechanical solenoid tap to right cheek

stimulus_type.source: Frontiers p. 5, Visual Stimuli and Fig. 3C–D and Frontiers pp. 3–4, Technological Components and Fig. 2

source_provenance.value: Virtual ball superimposed on stereoscopic recording in RealiSM. ExpyVR coordinates stimuli and responses.
source_provenance.source: Frontiers pp. 3–4, Technological Components and Fig. 2 and Frontiers p. 5, Visual Stimuli and Fig. 3C–D
source_provenance.gap: Original scene, model, XML schedule and source version unavailable.

trajectory_count.gap: The procedure specifies one looming ball path.

trajectory_path.source: Frontiers p. 5, Visual Stimuli and Fig. 3C–D and Frontiers p. 6, Procedure
trajectory_path.gap: Published nominal path is 200 cm. The reported 75 cm/s × 2.6 s gives 195 cm. Start position and contact geometry require the original scene settings for exact reproduction.

stimulus_duration.source: Frontiers p. 6, Procedure and Frontiers pp. 3–4, Technological Components and Fig. 2

stimulus_speed.source: Frontiers p. 5, Visual Stimuli and Fig. 3C–D and Frontiers p. 6, Procedure

gain_envelope.gap: Experiment 1 has no task-irrelevant audio probe.

value.scene_capture: Seven stereoscopic GoPro Hero4 pairs on 3D 360hero 3DH3PRO14H rig
value.video_stitching: Two panoramic views, one per eye
value.audio_capture: Four pairs of 3Dio Omni binaural microphones with interpolation between directions
value.body_view: First-person stereoscopic video of the user's own body overlaid on the panoramic scene
value.tracking: Head rotation around the captured viewpoint

renderer_or_apparatus.source: Frontiers pp. 3–4, Technological Components and Fig. 2
renderer_or_apparatus.gap: No source project or hardware latency measurements.

trial_rows_families.source: Frontiers pp. 5–6, Experimental Design and Procedure
trial_rows_families.gap: The paper describes a general 70%/20%/10% design. The Experiment 1 counts imply 72%/16%/12%. Use the stated 300-trial counts for Experiment 1.

condition_intermixing.value: Visuotactile, tactile-only and visual-only catch trials randomly intermixed.

blocked_or_random_order.value: Four 75-trial blocks, approximately seven minutes each. Random trial order.
blocked_or_random_order.gap: Exact per-block family balance, randomization procedure and seed unreported.

iti_jitter_policy.gap: Fixation is described as between trials. The phases sum to 5000 ms. Separate ITI and jitter details are unreported.

response_window.gap: The article specifies speeded button detection. Online timeout and RT inclusion window unreported.

task_sequence_rules.value: Respond quickly and accurately to a cheek tap. Ignore the approaching ball. Withhold for catch trials.
task_sequence_rules.source: Frontiers pp. 5–6, Experimental Design and Procedure

tactile_stimulus.source: Frontiers pp. 3–4, Technological Components and Fig. 2
tactile_stimulus.gap: Amplitude, pulse calibration and threshold procedure unreported.

value.mapping: D1 is closest and corresponds to the last temporal delay.

soa_table.source: Frontiers pp. 5–6, Experimental Design and Procedure and Frontiers pp. 7–8, Experiment 1 Results and Fig. 4
soa_table.gap: Exact delay offsets and distances are unreported. Fig. 4 uses categorical labels.

baseline_strategy.value: Tactile-only trials at six delays. Subtract each participant's fastest mean tactile-only delay from every multisensory delay mean.
baseline_strategy.source: Frontiers pp. 6–7, Analysis and Eq. 1 and Frontiers pp. 7–8, Experiment 1 Results and Fig. 4

value.timing: same number of levels as visuotactile

catch_trial_type.value: Visual-only virtual ball with no tactile pulse.
catch_trial_type.source: Frontiers pp. 5–6, Experimental Design and Procedure

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.gap: Per delay across the full experiment.

implementation_gaps: The source stereoscopic scene and first-person body capture, tennis-ball placement, exact tactile delay table and participant-specific geometry are unavailable.

Requires rendering of the scene and approaching ball against a calibrated headset clock with 10 ms mechanical right-cheek stimulation and an aligned button response. The audio-tactile runner does not reproduce the mixed-reality task.
reference_parameters.planner_scope: The study settings describe the source procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for this profile.

provenance.source: https://doi.org/10.3389/fict.2017.00031. Frontiers p. 6, Procedure and Frontiers pp. 7–8, Experiment 1 Results and Fig. 4
